name: TAKE_CARE_YELLOW_SQUARE
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q18_5 'TAKE CARE' panel, 600 x 600: one panel of the modular W5-Q18_5 to _9 wildlife assembly (the sheet's 'example use': a 600 symbol panel beside TAKE CARE over the 1200 x 300 RECENT CROSSINGS panel); square corners, black border 25, no edge strip, as dimensioned. Chain 110 / 140D / 100 / 140D / 110 = 600: cap tops 110, 350. Black on Class 400 retroreflective yellow.
